summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) mobile icon-only round WA floating button and (2) Pengalaman Klien testimonials section placed before Artikel & Panduan on Beranda. All acceptance criteria pass at 390/768/1440.
critical_code_review_comments: WA floating button at 390px correctly becomes 56x56 circle (border-radius:50%), label .wa-float-label display:none, href=wa.me/628977430802 with aria-label='Chat WhatsApp'. Position right:16, bottom:16.
At tablet 768px and desktop 1440px the pill retains 'Chat WhatsApp' text (169x52, border-radius:999px, label display:block) — matches spec (icon-only applies <=640px).
home-testimonials sits before home-articles (verified via scrollY: 13058 < 14556 and DOM order flag).

Testimonials section: eyebrow 'Pengalaman Klien' and title 'Cerita dari Mereka yang Telah Bekerja Sama dengan Kami.' present; 3 cards [testimonial-card-0..2]; each shows 'Contoh' badge [testimonial-sample-badge-0..2]; placeholder names/roles/services visible; reveal animation triggers after scroll.
Mobile 390px: grid is single column (gridTemplateColumns=358px), no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth===innerWidth===390).

Mobile footer: visually the WA circle does not occlude the footer copyright or Kebijakan Privasi/Syarat & Ketentuan links thanks to padding-bottom:96px; bbox intersection with the footer-bottom container exists but text is left-aligned while WA is bottom-right, so no occlusion of text — acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified mobile round WA + testimonials section ordering/content/responsiveness. Screenshots: /app/.screenshots/mobile_testi.png, mobile_footer.png, desktop_testi.png. Known out-of-scope (from iteration_1): desktop WA pill may overlap right-aligned footer-bottom links at full scroll — not addressed here.
